No code exfiltrates data or executes untrusted payloads at parse time. Therefore, running makepkg --printsrcinfo is safe.
</details>

No network downloads of untrusted code, no execution of arbitrary commands, and no use of dangerous constructs such as eval, base64, curl, or wget are present.
